title: Defenses Against Prompt Attacks Learn Surface Heuristics
authors: Shawn Li; Chenxiao Yu; Zhiyu Ni; Hao Li; Charith Peris; Chaowei Xiao; Yue Zhao
why_relevant: Analyzes failure modes of supervised fine-tuning defenses against prompt injection, including indirect injection via retrieved content relevant to RAG. Identifies shortcut biases (position, token trigger, topic) that cause over-rejection, informing defense design for RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on prompt-injection defenses generally rather than RAG-specific pipelines; RAG is one motivating application.
